blocks.title: Waterfall model
blocks.text: Waterfall model ek seedha tareeqa hai jis mein project ka har marhala agle ke shuru hone se pehle mukammal hona chahiye, jaise aabshar (waterfall) ek satah se agli par girti hai. Yeh linear aur tarteeb-war hai: aap marahil se tarteeb mein guzarte hain aur marhala mukammal hone ke baad wapas nahi jate (Fig. 1.2).

items: Requirements: software ko kya karna hai, jama aur darj karna.
Design: mansooba ke software kaise banega aur dikhega.
Testing: masail ya bugs jaanchna aur theek karna.
Deployment: software users ke liye jaari karna.
Maintenance: istemal ke baad update aur masail theek karna.

blocks.caption: Waterfall: fawaid aur hudood
rows: Saada aur samajhne mein aasan: wazeh, alag marahil
Be-lachak: mukammal marhale mein tabdeeli ke liye wapas jana mushkil aur mehnga
Tarteeb-war amal: ek waqt mein ek marhala, sambhalna aur track karna aasan
Pecheeda projects ke liye munasib nahi jin ki requirements badalti hon
Wazeh, mustaqil requirements wale chhote projects ke liye munasib
Khatra aur ghair yaqeeni: farz karta hai ke sab requirements shuru mein maloom hain

blocks.alt: Waterfall (Plan Driven) ke unwan ke neeche saat gehre neele teer baen se daen neeche utarte hain: Requirements, Analysis, Design, Implementation, Testing, Delivery aur Maintenance. Teeron ke neeche kaamon ki chhoti fehristein hain aur sab se neeche Project Timeline ka lamba teer hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.2: Waterfall Model (kitab ki Figure 1.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Marahil ke neeche chhape kaam: Requirements: project ka daira (scope) tay karna, stakeholders se interview, user research, requirements jama karna, kick-off meeting. Design: high-level design, design review, design mein tabdeeliyan, stakeholder ki manzoori. Implementation: dev phase 1, review, dev phase 2, review. Testing: testing, tabdeeliyan. Delivery: deployment.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teer sirf aage aur neeche jate hain, koi teer wapas oopar nahi jata: har marhala mukammal ho kar hi agla shuru hota hai, jaise aabshar (waterfall) ka pani sirf neeche girta hai. Neeche ka Project Timeline teer waqt (time) dikhata hai, yani Requirements sab se pehle aur Maintenance sab se aakhir mein aata hai. Figure ka 'Delivery' marhala wohi hai jise upar deployment kaha gaya hai.
Waterfall ki istilah sab se pehle Dr. Winston W. Royce ne 1970 mein pesh ki, magar unhon ne ise baghair dohrao (iteration) ke istemal karne ki himayat nahi ki.

blocks.prompt: Jis project ki requirements badalne ka imkan ho, us ke liye Waterfall model khatarnak kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh farz karta hai ke sab requirements shuru mein maloom hain aur mukammal marahil par wapas nahi jata, to der se aane wali tabdeeli design, code aur tests ka mehnga dobara kaam karwati hai; yeh wazeh, mustaqil requirements wale chhote projects ke liye munasib hai.

items: Waterfall: linear, tarteeb-war marahil (requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment, maintenance), wapsi nahi (Fig. 1.2).
Fawaid: saada, track karna aasan, chhote mustaqil projects ke liye acha; hudood: be-lachak, pecheeda ya badalte projects ke liye kamzor. Istilah Royce (1970) se.
